recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7556 unless the Vocabulary work group opens a new issue to change the current THO-linked external terminology guidance.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive Vocab issue reported that the table in 2015May ValueSet section 6.21.7.1 was missing data or not formatted properly; the accepted resolution was to tidy the table up.
initial_application: SVN revision 5678, represented by git commit c138c5bb380395b868c5a7337421d5225f2175a1, edited source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml to remove a broken separator row, add missing external code system links, and add an HL7 v2 table row showing no filters were defined.
additional_context: ValueSet and CodeSystem are active resources in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-10221 later moved generic filter definitions into active CodeSystem notes; FHIR-31938 removed NCI Metathesaurus because it is not a code system; and FHIR-35933 migrated external code system usage pages from core to HL7 Terminology. Current ValueSet notes point to CodeSystem filters and THO pages, while terminologies-systems.html still links external systems such as UNII, NDC, and CVX to THO guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding the old DSTU1 table entries or local external-terminology links would conflict with later final decisions and current source organization.
